title: Graph Eigenvalues and Projection Constants
summary: For an integer $k\ge2$, let $λ_k(G)$ denote the $k$th largest adjacency eigenvalue of a graph $G$. For every graph $G$ on $n$ vertices and every $2 \leq k \leq n$, we prove \[ λ_k(G) \le \frac{(k-2)\sqrt{k+1}+2}{2k(k-1)}\,n-1. \] Our bound is tight for $k\in\{2,3,4,8,24\}$. We obtain it by reducing the graph-eigenvalue problem to an extremal problem for orthogonal projections and then applying the general upper bound on the absolute projection constant $γ(r)$ due to Deręgowska and Lewandowska.
